address: Palace Hotel and Spa, 8 Ness Walk, Inverness,IV3 5NG
bio: Enjoy an indulgent Afternoon Tea at Palace Hotel & Spa. Located in Inverness, you'll enjoy stunning views overlooking Inverness Castle and the River Ness.  Afternoon Tea is served in the elegant Lounge, sophisticated Brasserie, or stylish Eight on the River Restaurant.  At the Palace, Afternoon Tea features a delicious selection of freshly made sandwiches using local produce and a decadent assortment of cakes and sweet treats. Not forgetting the freshly made scones, thick whipped double cream and lashings of local jam! This is served with a freshly brewed pot of tea or coffee, or guests can add Prosecco for that extra special experience.  Palace Hotel & Spa is located in the heart of Inverness, beside the River Ness and a short distance from Inverness station.  Afternoon Tea is only £21.95 per guest. Why not add a mini 200ml bottle of Prosecco with your Afternoon Tea only £31.95 per guest. Menu – items maybe subject to change
